verdict.rationale: The only MCP-related evidence is Sierra's engineering blog on an "MCP gateway" that connects AI agents to tools and systems. The quoted text frames this as infrastructure for Sierra's own company, not a documented customer-facing way to plug MCP servers into Sierra agents. Other integration evidence describes point-and-click wiring of internal APIs, not MCP. Missing for 10: documentation that customers can register their own MCP servers with Sierra agents, setup and configuration details for MCP tool use, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
